documents_expected.why: call page: who can apply, countries, categories and timeline
the call text: objectives, 50% cap per category, obligations, exclusion criteria, self-certification

eligibility.rule: Non-profits, local authorities, protected-area bodies, universities and research centres, non-profit public-private partnerships
eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants ● Non-profit organisations; ● Local authorities; ● Management bodies of protected areas and parks; ● Universities and research centres; ● Non-profit public-private partnerships.

eligibility.rule: Projects in Italy, France, Germany, Spain, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, Malta or Finland
eligibility.quote: The call is open to projects located in the following nine (9) European countries: Italy, France, Germany, Spain, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, Malta, and Finland.

eligibility.rule: Projects must restore land or river connectivity and include monitoring and data collection
eligibility.quote: To be eligible, projects must meet one or more of the following objectives, and all applications must include monitoring and data collection activities.

eligibility.rule: No routine maintenance, legally required or compensation works, or plain tree planting
eligibility.quote: Interventions already foreseen as mandatory by law or deriving from environmental compensation measures due to infrastructure works

eligibility.rule: Excluded: criminal or environmental convictions, insolvency, conflicts of interest
eligibility.quote: the following entities are strictly excluded from participating in the call (both as individual candidates and as partners)

eligibility.rule: Full budget transparency, including funds already available and in-kind contributions
eligibility.quote: The application requires the applicant to provide full transparency regarding the project budget, including the expected financial contribution from participation in the call, together with any financial resources already demonstrably available, plus in-kind contributions.

documents.item: Online application form on the REcommunity platform
documents.quote: Applications must be submitted using the appropriate online form on the Reintegration Economy Community pages of Fondazione Capellino and Almo Nature for all three categories starting July 1, 2026.

documents.item: Project budget with all funding sources and in-kind contributions
documents.quote: The application requires the applicant to provide full transparency regarding the project budget

documents.item: Signed declaration of honour (self-certification) on the exclusion criteria
documents.quote: When submitting the application, the applicant must sign a declaration of honor (self-certification) attesting that the exclusion criteria listed above are not met.

effort.step: Category B (up to €150,000): submit the online application
Category C (up to €450,000): submit the online application
If shortlisted, the project goes to a public vote
effort.quote: The strongest applications will first be selected by an internal panel before being put to a public vote.

co_finance_required.quote: Category A projects: maximum contribution of 50% of the project cost, up to a maximum of €50,000

notes: Category A (up to €50,000) closed on 30 September 2026. In every category the foundation pays at most 50% of the project cost, in instalments tied to progress (3, 5 or 10). Grantees must support the ECI, follow open-data principles and deliver audiovisual documentation, with funding suspended if it is missing. No written report schedule is published. The PDF gives a typo for Category B selection ('1st to 15th December 2027'); the web page says 2026.
